# GNU Unifont 17.0.04

`unifont-17.0.04.hex.gz` is the unmodified
[upstream GNU Unifont release artifact](https://unifoundry.com/pub/unifont/unifont-17.0.04/font-builds/unifont-17.0.04.hex.gz).
Copyright © 1998–2025 Roman Czyborra, Paul Hardy, Qianqian Fang, Andrew
Miller, Johnnie Weaver, David Corbett, Ælla Chiana Moskopp, Rebecca
Bettencourt, et al. See [the upstream font metadata](https://unifoundry.com/pub/unifont/unifont-17.0.04/doxygen/html/hex2otf_8h_source.html).
The font is distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 or GPL-2.0-or-later
with the GNU font embedding exception. Full terms are in LICENSE.txt.
Cerulia uses the SIL OFL option for the bundled bitmap data.

The build selects ranges and packs unchanged glyph pixels in a format for
Cerulia's framebuffer; see `tools/build_cjk.py` for ranges and the pinned checksum.
